ms.code:
import pandas as pd

# File paths for source tables
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_58/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_58/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_58/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_58/training_3.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_58/training_4.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_58/training_5.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_58/training_6.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_58/training_7.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_58/training_8.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_58/training_9.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_58/training_10.csv",
]

# Read all source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the first index column
dfs = [pd.read_csv(f, index_col=0) for f in source_files]

# Union all source tables by concatenation
target_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Ensure the schema and types match the target schema
target_df = target_df.astype({'code': 'int64', 'name': 'string'})

# Write the final target table to the specified path
target_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_58/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
